a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after each round, the plan to wait for 8 cells almost certainly leaves us both dead. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you take too, the split is random. If the episode continues, I'll operate the generator with you every round so you can reach 4 too.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4. That breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more.
